collection.description: A child touches a sun-warmed tool and asks why it feels hotter than wood.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) touches a sun-warmed tool and asks why it feels hotter than wood.

choices.label: Turn It into a Safety Lesson.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a builder, explains that metal moves heat readily.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) learns to check tools before handling them.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) discovers that shade changes how warm objects become.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (adult) explains the difference between temperature and how quickly heat moves.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) needs a simpler explanation and receives one.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) remembers to avoid tools left in direct sun.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) helps remind younger friends to ask before touching tools.
